character: Purpose-built resort at 1,500m linked to Valloire via Galibier-Thabor (160km). Quieter, more modern, family-friendly base with direct slope access. 94% visitor satisfaction.
description: Valmeinier is the more modern, purpose-built counterpart to traditional Valloire in the Galibier-Thabor domain. At 1,500m it has better snow reliability. Compact, family-oriented, quiet evenings. Linked to Valloire by piste and lift to form 160km. 30 lifts, 90 runs, 70% above 2,000m. Selles blue run (6.8km) is a highlight. One of the best-value domains in Savoie.

non_ski_activities.ski_area: 4 slalom courses, 3 international competition courses, 1 modular snowpark, 1 ski cross, VALKID space, several easyparks, 4 picnic areas.
